record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: ALOLAN_GEODUDE, ALOLAN_GRAVELER and ALOLAN_GOLEM (the queued units; none has a passive in the catalog). The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and stats only.
record.summary: For each entity of another team in the 8 cells around the caster: paralyse it for 5000 ms (before reductions), then deal SPECIAL damage (25/50/100 raw at 1/2/3 stars; 200 at 4 stars). The cast target is not used; the area is always the caster's neighbours.

targeting.who: every other-team entity on the 8 cells adjacent to the caster at cast time; the cast target parameter is unused (a cast still needs a target in range because requiresTarget is the default true)

geometry.shape: the 8 adjacent cells, centre excluded, on-board only

effects.scaling: requested amount: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies each hit if true (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied amount: the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Applied after that enemy's paralysis; the damage return value is unused (no heal, no kill effect). No stat helper involved.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: the strategy leaves apBoost at its default false, so triggerParalysis does not multiply by (1 + AP/100)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: per enemy, before that enemy's damage; enemies are processed in getAdjacentCells order (row by row)
statusEffects.guards: not applied with runeProtect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; STORM weather x1.3, then x(1 - 0.2 x ELECTRIC_QUARTZ count of the enemy's player); then applyStatusDurationReductions on the enemy itself (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then -10% per ODD_KEYSTONE); the timer keeps the larger of the existing remaining time and the new request; a CHERI_BERRY holder eats the berry after a successful application. Because the strategy passes the adjacent enemy itself as the pkm argument, the reductions, the STORM item count and the Cheri Berry check all read that enemy.
statusEffects.combatEffect: a paralysed unit uses half speed for its attack cooldown (attacking-state) and its movement speed (move-speed), and cannot dodge basic attacks (handleAttack). Other uses of status.paralysis (bug-buzz, force-palm, zing-zap, synergies.ts, passives.ts) were seen but not read.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (200, also the fallback) is not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 100 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: Only the 8 cells around the caster at cast time; empty cells and allies are skipped. The caster needs a target in range to cast, but that target is not otherwise used (it is hit only if it is adjacent and an enemy).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes. Each cast re-applies paralysis (timer keeps the larger value) and damages again.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): damage 25/50/100 per adjacent enemy (200 at 4 stars) and paralysis 5000 ms. Applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and later handleDamage modifiers. Applied paralysis = 5000 ms (no AP), x1.3 under STORM (less ELECTRIC_QUARTZ), then the enemy's duration reductions, kept only if longer than the remaining time. No heal or stat change, so no Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helper applies.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting before the cast)
